__meta__:

    category: Workshops
  deployer:

ocp4_installer_version: 4.20
ocp4_installer_root_url: https://artifacts.labcdn.example/ocp-clients
worker_instance_count: 2
workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_service_mesh
